name: tilt-card
title: Tilt Card
description: Tilt card for vertical reels: a card rises and tilts in 3D while its brand-red corner glow drifts, the headline lifted on its own depth. Kicker, headline and glow spread are fields. Brand palette, Montserrat, sized for the 780 px graphics field. Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="tilt-card": its own timeline nests there.

variables.label: Eyebrow
variables.description: Small uppercase kicker above the headline.

variables.label: Glow
variables.description: How far the corner glow reaches past the card edges, which sets both its spread at rest and how far the timeline drift carries it.
